reviewed_by: Claude Code, fixing goal pause failing the goal's in-flight turn
reason: Pausing a running goal cleared its execution claim while its turn still ran, so the turn's next ownership check discarded its output as stale and failed it; a quick resume was then left paused by that failure. ChatGoalService.write now keeps the claim on pause while a live (not ended) turn holds it, so the turn finishes and releases it and a still-paused goal starts no next step. A claim no live turn holds is released as before, so settle-time pauses after a failed or interrupted turn are unchanged. A chat or project hold's pause keeps the claim as #1289 made it. Selected: test_chat_goals.py (new regressions for pause, pause-then-resume and the released-claim case), test_chat_holds.py (hold pause keeps the claim), plus the suites that pause goals or reconcile claims: recovery controls, project holds, goal execution waiting, goal revision races, subagent lifecycle, harness chat goals and orphan recovery.
exclusions: No UI, native or Playwright change: the goal API's response shape is unchanged and only the claim fields on a paused goal differ while a turn runs. Locally 194 passed and 63 skipped (PostgreSQL-only cases); CI runs them.
